edges.reason: transfer delegates its logic to transferFrom
transfer passes msg.sender as the sender to transferFrom
transferFrom authorizes based on msg.sender versus _from allowance
transferFrom calls ensure before moving balances
ensure grants a bypass when _from or _to is the owner
ensure reads tradeAddress as part of the whitelist check
ensure calls condition to validate sale limits
ensure checks canSale whitelist mapping
condition reads _saleNum to bound sales per address
condition reads _onSaleNum to bound sales per address
condition compares value against _minSale
condition compares value against _maxSale
delegate requires msg.sender to equal owner
delegate executes an attacker-controlled delegatecall
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or hardcoded address
_mints marks the spender as sellable
_mints computes and overwrites balances with unchecked multiplication
init requires msg.sender to equal owner
init multiplies sale limits by 10**decimals without SafeMath
batchSend requires msg.sender to equal owner
batchSend multiplies _value by array length and credits balances unchecked
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender to equal owner
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry
constructor assigns owner from msg.sender
constructor stores msg.sender as owner
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner
approve writes into the allowance mapping
transferFrom mutates allowance and balances with unchecked subtraction and addition
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping
transferFrom increments the per-address sale counter

normalization_plan.reason: _from is the sender parameter consumed by transferFrom
_to is the recipient parameter consumed by transferFrom
_value is the amount parameter consumed by transferFrom
_UNI is a local computed pair address used only inside ensure
saleNum is the sale count parameter assigned by init
token is the min sale parameter scaled by init
maxToken is the max sale parameter scaled by init
spender is the recipient parameter mutated by _mints
addedValue is the minted amount parameter used by _mints
_tos is the recipient array parameter iterated by batchSend
addr is the address parameter stored by setTradeAddress
a is the target address parameter passed to delegatecall in delegate
b is the calldata parameter passed to delegatecall in delegate
